assessment: The source explicitly defines the leading-order CP asymmetry as (alpha_Xi + anti-alpha_Xi)/(alpha_Xi - anti-alpha_Xi) and reports the current and previous-best central values for both decay parameters. The card preserves the exact relation, sign convention, controls, dimensionless readout, values, applicability, and locators. Although the table reports two matched measurement pairs rather than all four cross-combinations, the equation is a source-defined leading-order observable for any admissible Xi and charge-conjugate decay-parameter pair, so applying it to the Cartesian product does not assert unreported measurements.

issues.detail: The table reports current and previous-best alpha_Xi and anti-alpha_Xi as matched pairs; the two cross-pairs are not published measurements. This is non-blocking because the source independently defines A_CP at leading order as a deterministic function of the two decay parameters.

controls.definition: Decay parameter alpha_Xi for Xi- to Lambda pi-.
controls.name: xi_decay_parameter

controls.definition: Charge-conjugate decay parameter anti-alpha_Xi for anti-Xi+ to anti-Lambda pi+.
controls.name: anti_xi_decay_parameter

applicability.statement: The relation is the leading-order definition of A_CP for the Xi and charge-conjugate Xi decay parameters.
The allowed control values are the central values from this work and the previous best results listed for the corresponding Xi decay parameters.

readouts.definition: Leading-order CP asymmetry observable A_CP for the Xi hyperon decay parameters.
readouts.name: xi_cp_asymmetry
